to: you: each character that gets credit for the kill

fields.name: mtype
fields.description: The monster type, a key of `G.monsters`.

senders.what: `issue_monster_awards`, for a cooperative monster: each online character with a share of the points above 0.0025. It comes before the drops and the XP.

`issue_monster_award`, when the character has no party: the character that the monster targets. That is the killer only if the monster had no target, or on servers with `B.free_last_hits` (hardcore, dungeon).
`issue_monster_award`, when that character has a party: each online member of the party, on any map.
A kill in the Cave of Many Dreams: each cave player in the instance, within 800 px of the monster.
